evidence_limits: Original material comes from the pinned repository. New files only extract or capture existing content and record verification; no experiments or checker execution were performed.
The copied HTML/CSS/JS are byte-identical to the pinned original; dashboard metrics, seeded logs, photo analysis and daily review are hard-coded fixtures.
Uploaded files are previewed with FileReader; analyzer callbacks return fixed text rather than inspecting the image.
Ingredient suggestions use keyword matching; no model inference, clinical, nutrition or recommendation validity was verified.
Original form values are inserted using innerHTML without sanitization. Preserve the copy as evidence; isolate an embedded demo and avoid using personal inputs.
Browser QA covers manual forms, mode toggle, keyword suggestions, daily review, reload and a 390px viewport. Photo input paths were source-inspected only.
The desktop app browser helper was unavailable; verification used already installed Edge and Python Playwright instead.
